Two facts frame the options: a fixed-seed 2-sigma gate fails about 4.55% of the time and is re-drawn whenever the sample points change, and a larger budget alone gives no seed a margin while the gate is measured in sigma. (d) A two-stage gate: on a 2-sigma failure, rerun once with one predetermined second seed and require it to be within 2 sigma.
